title: 32nd Floor?
content: Exited onto the 32nd floor right into a beautiful, ornate bedroom. Beach views and I sense a child like giddyness to the experience. I began exploring more and under a wood framed study chair, a canary yellow PA speaker was positioned. I jumped onto the edge of the bed with a nervous tension, like I was being called into he principals office. Context 35 year old entrepreneur Single 11 Birth Number Born on 8th Chat with JC everyday
